title: joi: quadratic-time split in `string().email({ multiple: true })` allows denial of service (CVE-2026-118772)
description: A denial of service vulnerability exists in the joi library's string email validation when using the multiple option. The email validation splits input strings using a regular expression that performs in quadratic time on long runs of whitespace, causing the Node.js event loop to block for several seconds with large whitespace inputs. This affects joi versions from 16.0.0 through 17.13.8 and 18.0.0 through 18.3.0. The issue is fixed in joi versions 17.13.9 and 18.3.1.
